svg.aria-label: Experiment 03: resetting the inventory consumer group's offset backwards redelivers 106 already-processed booking.created events. The idempotency guard skips every one of them: the duplicate-skip counter rises by exactly 106 while the reservations counter stays flat, and no persisted state changes.

svg.text: Kafka can redeliver: a rebalance, a retry, a producer re-send, an offset replay. Correctness cannot depend on that never happening.

svg.text: Quiesce the apps so the group has no members, reset only inventory-service's offset on booking.created, resume.

svg.text: The resulting lag is exactly the number of events that will be redelivered: 106.
